map.📚 深度解析：承保利润（保费−赔款−费用）: 📚 Deep Dive: Underwriting Profit (Premium - Claims - Expenses)
map.承保利润 = 1000−650−250 = 100 万。即承保端利润 100 万: Underwriting profit = 10M - 6.5M - 2.5M = 1M. That is, the underwriting-side profit is 1M,
map.一致：(1000−650−250)=100万 = 1000×(1−0.9)=10: Yes: (10M - 6.5M - 2.5M) = 1M = 10M × (1 - 0.9) = 1M; at CR = 90% the two methods are equivalent.
map.承保利润为负但公司还赚钱？: Underwriting profit negative but company still profitable?
map.可能。承保亏损可由投资收益弥补（利差益），这是保险商业模式核心。但若连续承保巨亏: Possible. Underwriting loss can be offset by investment income (interest spread), the core of the insurance business model. But if underwriting keeps losing heavily and investment cannot cover it, that is an operating warning sign.
map.承保利润（本页代码口径，金额口径）：承保利润=保费收入−赔款支出−营运费用（元，: Underwriting profit (code basis on this page, amount basis): underwriting profit = premium income − claims − operating expenses (CNY, shown with thousands separators); underwriting margin = underwriting profit ÷ premium × 100 (%). Validation: all three fields are required and must be valid numbers, otherwise it prompts and stops. Rule: no fixed grading; a positive margin means underwriting profit and a negative one means an underwriting loss.
